Veterans Day 2026 is Wednesday, Nov. 11. The Veterans Day discounts list was created in 2021, recreated and verified this year on Oct. 22, 2026, but updated continuously through Nov. 11, 2026.

This 2026 Veterans Day discounts list will be updated as we learn of more nationally available Veterans Day discounts, meals or other ways businesses and organizations want to give back to Veterans and their families. These Veterans Day discounts, free meals and other programs are being shared so that Veterans, their families, caregivers and survivors are aware of all resources available to them.

Offers are subject to change and may not be available in all states and locations. Verify with the organization offering.

Veterans Day discounts: Restaurants

AAFES: @ShopMyExchange is saluting service with big savings: From Nov. 6 through Nov. 12, Exchange shoppers can find deals on electronics, clothing, shoes and more. MILITARY STAR® cardmembers can unlock even more savings, including an extra 10% off select items.

Applebee’s: Veterans and active duty receive a free dine‑in entrée from a special Veterans Day menu on Nov. 11, 2026. Proof of service required; beverages and gratuity not included.

Aspen Creek Grill: Offers Veterans and active duty a free $15 meal voucher on Nov. 11, 2026 (available 11 a.m. – 6 p.m.). Voucher redeemable through Dec. 24, 2026. Dine‑in only and ID required.

Bar Louie: Veterans and active duty get a free burger (excluding the Big Louie) on Nov. 10–11, 2026; dine‑in only and ID required.

Biscuit Belly: Free breakfast biscuit sandwich and coffee or fountain drink. Dine-in only; all locations listed.

Bob Evans: Provides Veterans and active duty a free meal from a special menu on Nov. 11, 2026; dine‑in only; valid service ID required.

Bonefish Grill: Veterans, active duty and families receive a free Bang Bang Shrimp entrée plus a nonalcoholic beverage on Nov. 11, 2026 with ID.

Bubbakoo’s is honoring Veterans and active duty military members with a free chicken or beef burrito or bowl. The offer is available all day in-restaurant with a valid military ID and no purchase is required. The offer is valid for in-restaurant orders only, with additional charges for modifiers and add-ons.

Chili’s: At participating locations, Veterans and active duty receive a free entrée from a select Veterans Day menu on Nov. 11, 2026; dine‑in only and ID required.

Circle K: This Veterans Day, Circle K is honoring Veterans with one free medium hot or iced coffee on Wednesday, Nov. 11, no additional purchase required. The one-day offer is available at participating Circle K locations across the U.S. Veterans can redeem it by presenting a valid military ID at purchase. 

Chipotle: At participating locations on Nov. 11, 2026, Veterans and active duty with ID receive free chips + choice of guac, queso blanco or salsa with a $5 purchase at participating locations.

Cotton Patch Cafe: Veterans and active duty get a free Chicken Fried Steak or Chicken Fried Chicken entrée on Nov. 11, 2026; dine‑in only with military ID.

Denny’s: Offers Veterans and active duty a free Original Grand Slam on Nov. 11, 2026, 5 a.m. to 12 p.m.; dine‑in only and ID required.

Freddy’s Frozen Custard & Steakburgers: Veterans and active duty who visit on Nov. 11, 2026, receive a free combo‑meal card redeemable through Nov. 25, 2026.

Golden Corral: Annual Military Appreciation Night on Nov. 11, 2026, offering Veterans a free buffet; dine‑in only.

Hoss’s Steak and Sea House: On Nov. 11, Veterans receive a free Soup, Salad, Bread, Nacho & Dessert Bar and an Iced Tea. Dine-in only. After dining, Veterans will receive a $10 off $40 voucher to be used on their next visit. Available while supplies last. Voucher expires 11/25/26.

Hot Dog on a Stick: This Veterans Day, Hot Dog on a Stick is honoring those who have served by offering a free 16 oz. Original Lemonade for Veterans and active duty military members on Wednesday, Nov. 11, at participating Hot Dog on a Stick locations nationwide to redeem the offer in-store with a valid military ID. No purchase is necessary.

In-N-Out Burger: On Nov. 11, Veterans, active duty military, Reserve and National Guard get a complimentary meal, including any burger, fries and beverage on In-N-Out Burger’s menu. All current and former members of the U.S. military will also receive a special-edition Veterans Day decal. Present proof of military service.

Margaritas Mexican Restaurant: Veterans get 50% off an entree on Nov. 11 when dining in at locations in the Northeast.

Marzoni’s Brick Oven & Brewing Co.: Veterans can receive one free 12 oz. draft beer or non-alcoholic drink on Nov. 11. Dine-in only. 1 drink per Veteran.

McCormick and Schmick’s: Veterans, Gold Star families and active duty receive a half‑priced entrée on Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026 (their traditional Veterans Appreciation Day).

Paisano’s Pizza: If you’re in the Delaware/Maryland/Virginia (and Washington, D.C.) area for Veterans Day, Paisano’s Pizza is offering a free Large 1-Topping Pizza to Veterans and active duty military at all 40 locations across the DMV on Wednesday, November 11, as a thank you to those who serve.

Playa Bowls: On Wednesday, November 11, Playa Bowls is offering 50% off bowls to all Veterans, active duty and retired military personnel at all shops nationwide. The offer is available in-shop only with a valid military ID. Guests can choose from Playa’s selection of made-to-order açaí, pitaya, coconut, mango and green bowls, topped with fresh fruit, granola and drizzles.

Prince St. Pizza: This Veterans Day, Prince St. Pizza is teaming up with NCIS: New York to give back to those who have served through a nationwide charitable initiative benefiting the American Red Cross Service to the Armed Forces program. On Wednesday, Nov. 11, Prince St. Pizza will donate 10% of in-store sales at participating locations to the organization, with NCIS: New York matching the donation up to $10,000. Additionally, Veterans and active duty military members can receive a complimentary slice at all locations nationwide. The collaboration also includes a special pop-up at Prince St. Pizza’s Brooklyn location, where NCIS: New York cast members Devin Druid, Shane Harper and Jacqueline Byers will hand out complimentary slices, sign autographs and take photos with attendees from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. ET.

Red Lobster: Veterans, active duty and reservists receive a free Shrimp & Chips meal on Nov. 11, 2026, dine‑in only; ID required.

Red Robin: Veterans and active duty get a free Red’s Big Tavern Burger with bottomless fries on Nov. 11, 2026; dine‑in only; ID required.

Rubio’s: On Nov. 11, buy one entrée, get one free for Veterans using code VETS26. Valid in-store only with military ID.

Ruby Tuesday: This Veterans Day, Ruby Tuesday is thanking the brave men and women who have served or are serving to try its new “Everyday Fresh Meals” for free, valued at up to $17.99. Offer good to Veterans and active duty military, including Reserve and National Guard, who show proof of military service. Offer includes a choice of one of 13 select entrées + The Garden Bar + a bottomless drink. Valid Wednesday, Nov. 11, 2026, for dine-in only at participating locations.

Shake Shack: Shake Shack is honoring Veterans Day on Wednesday, Nov. 11, and showing appreciation for those who serve with a free single ShackBurger. Active military personnel and Veterans can simply show a valid military ID or proof of service, no purchase required. The offer is available in-Shack nationwide.

Sizzler: On Nov. 11, from open until 4 p.m., Veterans and active duty service members can enjoy a complimentary lunch and non-alcoholic beverage. Guests can choose between three dishes: 6 oz. Tri-Tip Sirloin Steak, Malibu Chicken or half dozen Crispy Shrimp.

Smashburger: Offers Veterans a free All‑American Smashburger on Nov. 11, 2026 at participating locations; ID required.

Starbucks: Veterans, service members and spouses receive a free 12‑oz hot or iced brewed coffee on Nov. 11, 2026, at participating Starbucks stores.

Texas Roadhouse: On Veterans Day, Texas Roadhouse is honored to to offer free meals to Veterans and active military members across the country. Veterans and military should verify locally for participation.

Torchy’s Tacos: Provides veterans and active‑duty a free taco + drink on November 11, 2026; in‑store only; proof of service required.

Twin Peaks: On Wednesday, Nov. 11, Veterans and active duty military members can enjoy a complimentary entrée all day at any Twin Peaks restaurant nationwide. The dine-in offer requires a valid military ID and includes a choice of five meals, from a Cheeseburger & Fries or Chicken Tenders & Fries to a Chicken Caesar Salad, OG Pepperoni Flatbread or Boneless Wings & Fries. Twin Peaks is also extending its appreciation beyond Veterans Day. More details and participating locations online.

Veterans Canteen Service (VCS): Veterans can get a free breakfast combo meal at their local VCS PatriotCafé and free brewed value coffee at PatriotBrew coffee shops the morning of Tuesday, Nov. 10. There is no purchase necessary.

WOB Bar & Kitchen: WOB is honoring the brave men and women who have served and continue to serve our country this Veterans Day with a complimentary meal at participating locations nationwide. On Wednesday, Nov. 11, veterans and active-duty service members are invited to enjoy a free Smash Burger and a side of fries as a small token of appreciation for their service and sacrifice.

Yard House: Veterans and active duty military receive a free appetizer on Nov. 11, 2026. Ask your server for details.

Veterans Day discounts: Retail & grocery

Food Lion: Veterans and active duty service members receive 10% off in‑store on Nov. 11, 2026, with military ID and MVP card; exclusions apply.

Kohl’s: Provides 30% off in‑store for military, veterans, and families on November 10-11, 2026, with valid ID; exclusions apply.

Publix: Offers 10% off groceries on Nov. 11, 2026 for Veterans, active duty and families with proof of service; standard exclusions apply.

Rack Room Shoes: Offers 20% off in‑store on Veterans Day for Veterans, active duty and dependents; ID required.

Target: In conjunction with Veterans Day, Target is offering a Target Circle Military Appreciation Discount of 20% off one qualifying storewide purchase from Nov. 5 through Nov. 11 to verified military members, Veterans and their families who are Target Circle members.

Tractor Supply Company: Verified military through Hometown Heroes receive 10% off on Veterans Day, plus year‑round perks like quarterly 5% off coupons and 2% rewards.

Veterans Canteen Service (VCS): VCS is offering a $399 (regular price $450) special price on 11-inch iPads. This deal is only available Nov. 9-10 and 12, and in-store only. [Editor: All deals in this list are linked to a source. This deal came to VA News directly from VCS representative for in-store only. There will be a webpage with ad graphics in the week leading up to Veterans Day.]

Walgreens: Exclusive 20% off eligible regular priced items in-store for Veterans, active duty military personnel and their immediate families. Standard exclusions and restrictions apply.

Veterans Day discounts: Personal care

Great Clips: Veterans and active duty receive a free haircut on Nov. 11, 2026; anyone getting a haircut that day can request a free haircut card to give a Veteran.

Sport Clips: Participating locations provide free or discounted haircuts on Nov. 11, 2026 for Veterans and service members with valid ID.

Veterans Day discounts: Attractions, museums & recreation

American Forces Travel: Your next cruise with American Forces Travel could earn you a $100 hotel coupon! Book a qualifying 6+ night cruise between Nov. 3–17, 2026, and use your hotel coupon to extend the adventure with a stay before you set sail or after you return. Valid on sailings through Dec. 31, 2027.

American Revolution Museum at Yorktown & Jamestown Settlement (VA): Free admission for military, Veterans, and up to three direct family members on Nov. 11, 2026; includes ceremonies and artillery salute.

Aquarium of the Pacific: Veterans and active duty receive free admission on Nov. 11, 2026; advance reservations required due to limited capacity.

Colonial Williamsburg: Provides free admission for active duty, retirees, Veterans, Guard/Reserve, and dependents from Nov. 6–11, 2026; ID required.

Eisenhower Presidential Library & Museum (Abilene, Kansas): Free museum admission on Nov. 11, 2026, from 9 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. CT.

Harley‑Davidson Museum (Milwaukee, Wisconsin): Free admission on Nov. 11, 2026, for Veterans and active duty military plus one adult guest and up to four children; also 10% off at the shop and restaurant onsite.

Legoland Florida and New York: Free admission to eligible military personnel, Veterans and first responders, plus discounted tickets for accompanying guests. Offer dates: Oct. 1–Nov. 30, 2026, including Veterans Day, on Nov. 11. Eligibility: U.S. military personnel, Veterans, law enforcement officers, firefighters, EMTs and EMS personnel.

Mount Vernon: Offers free admission to active duty and Veterans on Nov. 11, 2026, with special programming.

Museum of the American Revolution: Free admission for active duty, Veterans and Blue Star families from Nov. 8–11, 2026.

National WWI Museum and Memorial: Provides free admission for Veterans and active duty during Veterans Day Weekend 2026 (Nov. 6–9 & 11); the public receives half‑price admission.

National Parks Service: All visitors enjoy free park entry on Nov. 11, 2026; military and Veterans also qualify for free annual/lifetime passes.

Old Town Trolley – Savannah: Veterans, active duty, and first responders receive free admission on November 11, 2026 to listed attractions with valid ID.

Old Town Trolley – St. Augustine: Offers free admission on Nov. 11, 2026 for Veterans, active duty and first responders at select attractions with valid ID.

San Antonio Zoo: Provides free admission in November 2026 for Veterans and active duty; up to four family members receive 50% off. ID required.

Veterans Day discounts: Car care

AutoNation: is offering Veterans and active duty service members 15% off services, parts and accessories on Veterans Day and year-round at AutoNation-branded locations nationwide. During the month of November, eligible customers can also receive 15% off through AutoNation Mobile Service.

Grace for Vets: Participating locations nationwide offer free car washes to all Veterans and active duty personnel on Nov. 11, 2026.

ModWash: The express car wash with 134 locations in 12 states is honoring first responders and Veterans with a special deal through Veterans Day: one month of membership for the cost of one wash. Monthly memberships renew at the regular price. Veterans and active duty military personnel receive 10% off monthly renewals with a valid military ID. Applicable taxes may apply.
